import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

os.umask(0o022)
root = Path("/home/eileenspectremoon/loa-dev/loa-aleph")
out = Path("/tmp/SYNTHETIC-SRC001-PREP-7ec21d2-checks")
out.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
protocol = "calibration/src-001/replay/protocol/sha256-52e1f1bae4cbf91dbaf9699b69bad5885e37ce503db7fcb16ea2fe32a0e10ed8/src/cli.ts"
def sha(b):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def write(name, value):
    b = (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()
    with (out / name).open("xb") as f:
        f.write(b)
    (out / name).chmod(0o644)
head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%H %T"], cwd=root).decode().strip()
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1"], cwd=root) == b""
environment = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ["PATH", "HOME", "USER", "LOGNAME", "SHELL", "LANG", "LC_ALL"] if k in os.environ}
environment.update({"TZ": "UTC", "LC_ALL": "C.UTF-8", "npm_config_audit": "false", "npm_config_fund": "false", "npm_config_update_notifier": "false"})
commands = [
    ("01-diff", ["git", "diff", "--check"]),
    ("02-core-a", ["node", "scripts/validate-core-boundary.ts", "--json"]),
    ("03-core-b", ["node", "scripts/validate-core-boundary.ts", "--json"]),
    ("04-runtime-a", ["npm", "run", "runtime:check"]),
    ("05-runtime-b", ["npm", "run", "runtime:check"]),
    ("06-protocol-a", ["node", protocol, "verify-protocol"]),
    ("07-protocol-b", ["node", protocol, "verify-protocol"]),
    ("08-harness-typecheck", ["node", "node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc", "-p", "calibration/src-001/replay/tests/tsconfig.json", "--noEmit"]),
    ("09-harness-a", ["node", "calibration/src-001/replay/tests/test-harness.ts", "--report", str(out / "harness-a.json")]),
    ("10-harness-b", ["node", "calibration/src-001/replay/tests/test-harness.ts", "--report", str(out / "harness-b.json")]),
    ("11-regression", ["npm", "test"]),
]
results = []
for name, args in commands:
    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, env=environment, capture_output=True)
    d = {"name": name, "argv": args, "cwd": str(root), "head_and_tree": head,
         "started_at": start, "finished_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
         "exit": str(p.returncode), "stdout": p.stdout.decode(), "stderr": p.stderr.decode(),
         "stdout_sha256": sha(p.stdout), "stderr_sha256": sha(p.stderr)}
    write(name + ".json", d)
    results.append(d)
    print(name, "exit=" + str(p.returncode), sha(p.stdout), flush=True)
    if p.returncode:
        print(p.stdout.decode()[-4500:], p.stderr.decode()[-2500:], flush=True)
        break
repeat = []
for a, b in [("02-core-a", "03-core-b"), ("04-runtime-a", "05-runtime-b"), ("06-protocol-a", "07-protocol-b")]:
    left = next((x for x in results if x["name"] == a), None)
    right = next((x for x in results if x["name"] == b), None)
    if left and right:
        repeat.append({"left": a, "right": b, "stdout_byte_equal": left["stdout"] == right["stdout"],
                       "stderr_byte_equal": left["stderr"] == right["stderr"], "normalization": "NONE"})
if (out / "harness-a.json").exists() and (out / "harness-b.json").exists():
    a = (out / "harness-a.json").read_bytes()
    b = (out / "harness-b.json").read_bytes()
    repeat.append({"left": "harness-a.json", "right": "harness-b.json", "byte_equal": a == b,
                   "byte_length_A": str(len(a)), "byte_length_B": str(len(b)),
                   "sha256_A": sha(a), "sha256_B": sha(b), "normalization": "NONE"})
write("summary.json", {"format": "src001-preparation-check-invocations/v1",
    "preparation_id": "PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2", "head_and_tree": head,
    "script_source": Path(__file__).read_text(), "script_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
    "umask": "0022", "environment": environment,
    "credential_environment_policy": "Only named ordinary process variables inherited; provider/credential/session variables omitted. Existing HOME value retained, not repurposed.",
    "commands": [{"name": x["name"], "argv": x["argv"], "exit": x["exit"]} for x in results],
    "repeatability": repeat,
    "post_status_porcelain": subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1"], cwd=root).decode(),
    "limits": ["No syscall/network capture is claimed.", "Harness and generic regression fixtures are synthetic evidence, not genuine replay or reference comparison."]})
print("Checks retained at", str(out), flush=True)
